verdict.rationale: Parse and Extract return results in open formats (markdown, text, JSON) through the API and SDKs. Teams can also bring their own vector database or self-host via BYOC/Helm, which keeps data under their control and reduces lock-in. However, nothing documents a bulk account-level export of all stored data (jobs, saved configurations, indexes) or an offboarding/deletion path. Missing for 10: documented full-account data export, export of saved extraction/classification configs and hosted indexes, documented offboarding/data-deletion process, independent corroboration of leaving cleanly.
